changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_resources (role_id, resource_id, created_date, created_by) SELECT DISTINCT r.id, res.id, NOW(), 'system' FROM (VALUES ('BUYER','MATERIALS_FINISHING'), ('BUYER','MATERIALS'), ('BUYER','MATERIAL_CATEGORIES'), ('BUYER','MATERIAL_TYPES'), ('BUYER','MATERIAL_PRODUCERS'), ('BUYER','MEASUREMENT_UNITS'), ('BUYER','VAT_RATES'), ('BUYER','CURRENCIES'), ('BUYER','DELIVERY_CATEGORIES'), ('BUYER','DELIVERY_STATUSES'), ('BUYER','MATERIAL_SELLERS'), ('BUYER','NOTIFICATIONS'), ('MANAGER','MATERIAL_SELLERS') ) g(role_code, res_code) JOIN roles r ON r.code = g.role_code JOIN resources res ON res.code = g.res_code WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resources x WHERE x.role_id = r.id AND x.resource_id = res.id );

INSERT INTO role_resource_operations (role_resource_id, operation_id) SELECT rr.id, o.id FROM (VALUES ('BUYER','MATERIALS_FINISHING','READ'), ('BUYER','MATERIALS','READ'), ('BUYER','MATERIAL_CATEGORIES','READ'), ('BUYER','MATERIAL_TYPES','READ'), ('BUYER','MATERIAL_PRODUCERS','READ'), ('BUYER','MEASUREMENT_UNITS','READ'), ('BUYER','VAT_RATES','READ'), ('BUYER','CURRENCIES','READ'), ('BUYER','DELIVERY_CATEGORIES','READ'), ('BUYER','DELIVERY_STATUSES','READ'), ('BUYER','MATERIAL_SELLERS','READ'), ('BUYER','MATERIAL_SELLERS','CREATE'), ('BUYER','MATERIAL_SELLERS','UPDATE'), ('MANAGER','MATERIAL_SELLERS','CREATE') ) g(role_code, res_code, op_code) JOIN roles r ON r.code = g.role_code JOIN resources res ON res.code = g.res_code JOIN role_resources rr ON rr.role_id = r.id AND rr.resource_id = res.id JOIN operations o ON o.code = g.op_code WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resource_operations x WHERE x.role_resource_id = rr.id AND x.operation_id = o.id );

INSERT INTO role_resource_operations (role_resource_id, operation_id) SELECT brr.id, frro.operation_id FROM role_resources frr JOIN roles fr ON fr.id = frr.role_id AND fr.code = 'FOREMAN' JOIN resources res ON res.id = frr.resource_id AND res.code = 'NOTIFICATIONS' JOIN role_resource_operations frro ON frro.role_resource_id = frr.id JOIN roles br ON br.code = 'BUYER' JOIN role_resources brr ON brr.role_id = br.id AND brr.resource_id = res.id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resource_operations x WHERE x.role_resource_id = brr.id AND x.operation_id = frro.operation_id );
